en_blocks.三个信息来源，按可信度排序: Three sources of information, in order of trust
en_blocks.能确定什么: What can be stated with it
en_blocks.应聘岗位 / 城市 / 薪资带 / 年限 /（旧格式）年龄: Applied role / city / salary band / years / (old format) age
en_blocks.技能、学历、经历（脏： SolidWorks 常成 Solitvedks ）: Skills, education, history (dirty: SolidWorks often comes out as Solitvedks)
en_blocks.规则只有一条： 读不到就是未知 。一份没 OCR 出学历的简历，不会变成「学历=: There is exactly one rule: what we cannot read is unknown. A résumé with no OCRed education line does not become “education = 0” — it is recorded as missing_education. This rule comes back again and again.
en_blocks.三层：公理 / 个体 / 蕴含（实时计数）: Three layers: axioms / individuals / entailment (live counts)
en_blocks.这些数字来自 /api/ontology/talent_v1/metrics/c: These numbers come from /api/ontology/talent_v1/metrics/cards — the panels and this page read the same compiled result.
en_blocks.abox.ttl 里长这样: It looks like this in abox.ttl
en_blocks.:cand_业务跟单_东莞_6_10K_刘___3年 a :Candidate: :cand_业务跟单_东莞_6_10K_刘___3年 a :Candidate ; :appliedFor :role_业务跟单 ; :yearsExperience 3 ; :educationRank 3 ; :hasSkill :skill_跟单, :skill_Excel ; :sourceFile "…/【业务跟单_东莞 6-10K】刘__ 3年.pdf" . Property where it comes from :appliedFor the folder / file name :yearsExperience the file name (3年); otherwise :missingData :UnknownYears :educationRank OCR (2 中专/高中 · 3 大专 · 4 本科 · 5 硕士) :hasSkill OCR + typo-tolerant regex; nothing recognised → :UnknownSkills :sourceFile the file it came from — every answer traces back to that scan Duplicate scans (the same person twice; 7 pairs in practice) are joined with owl:sameAs so the recommendation does not spend two slots on one person.
en_blocks.这个本体有多少个体: How many individuals this ontology holds
en_blocks.ABox 不在任何数据库表里；它被物化成 talent_db 的 8 张表 +: The ABox lives in no database table: it is materialised into 8 tables and 5 views in talent_db, and the metrics and panels read that materialisation. check_abox_sync keeps it row-by-row identical to a fresh reasoning run.
en_blocks.第一版错在这里: The first attempt got this wrong
en_blocks.错的写法（推理机一言不发）: The wrong way (the reasoner says nothing)
en_blocks.:SolidWorks a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassO: :SolidWorks a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf :CAD . :cand_01 :hasSkill :SolidWorks . No individual was ever declared as :SolidWorks, so “who knows CAD” is forever the empty set — the reasoner never says one wrong word, and the page still looks perfect.
en_blocks.对的写法：类别是类，技能是个体: The right way: categories are classes, skills are individuals
en_blocks.:CAD a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf :Skil: :CAD a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf :SkillTag . :SolidWorks a :CAD . # an individual belongs to a category :cand_01 :hasSkill :SolidWorks . Lesson two: the category declarations must be GENERATED from the vocabulary. The version that hand-wrote six categories and typed :CAD as :CAT matched nobody for the AutoCAD requirement.
en_blocks.技能类别与持有者（实时指标）: Skill categories and their holders (live metric)
en_blocks.一条只因为「技能是个体」才成立的查询: A query that only works because a skill is an individual
en_blocks.职务说明书说的，就是公理: What the job description says is the axiom
en_blocks.业务跟单（JD：2 年以上、跟单/Excel/行政任一、高中及以上）: 业务跟单 (JD: 2+ years, any of order-tracking/Excel/admin, high-school or above)
en_blocks.:skillsFor_业务跟单 ≡ ( :OrderTracking ⊔ :Sp: :skillsFor_业务跟单 ≡ ( :OrderTracking ⊔ :SpreadsheetSoftware ⊔ :AdminSkill ) :matches_业务跟单 ≡ :Candidate ⊓ (:hasSkill some :skillsFor_业务跟单) ⊓ (:yearsExperience some xsd:integer[>= 2]) ⊓ (:educationRank some xsd:integer[>= 2]) Why a union: the JD lists the tools the job uses. Demanding ALL of them left 1 qualified candidate out of 277; “at least one category” is what a shortlist means. After the change, 48 qualify (see step 5). Only a DL reasoner can judge the thresholds: pure-Python OWL 2 RL (owlrl) returns the empty set for classes containing xsd:minInclusive. This repository uses HermiT.
en_blocks.这一页是整个本体的理由: This page is the reason the ontology exists
en_blocks.数据只说「这个人有什么技能、几年经验」；JD 说「这个岗位要什么」。 「谁过线」: The data only says “this person has these skills, that many years”. The JD says “this role needs these things”. “Who clears the line” is written in no row at all — it is entailed.
en_blocks.# 直接查 ABox：0 行 SELECT ?c WHERE { ?c a :m: # query the ABox directly: 0 rows SELECT ?c WHERE { ?c a :matches_业务跟单 } # after HermiT: N rows (the type assertions are entailed) Self-checks (check_abox) A2 the entailment must exist and must NOT be asserted asserting it reports “copied answer, not a reasoned one” A7 falsification: drop the class definition → the members must vanish; a change nothing can undo proves nothing A4 consistency: an unsatisfiable class makes every entailment vacuous Live: the first six roles ✂ falsify: delete one rule and watch the answer disappear · delete the whole definition of 业务跟单 · delete one person's skill assertion Red on the left = type assertions found in abox.ttl; green on the right = after HermiT.
en_blocks.推理机不排序，规则排序: The reasoner does not rank; a rule ranks
en_blocks.DL 推理机只能判断「过不过线」，它对顺序没有意见。所以名次由一条写下来的规则算: A DL reasoner can only decide “clears the line or not”; it has no opinion about order. So the rank comes from a written rule: skills 60% + years 25% + education 15%, ties broken by years descending and then by id — stable tie handling, so a re-run never swaps people.
en_blocks.HermiT，从 JD 公理推出: HermiT, entailed from the JD axioms
en_blocks.check_abox_sync 重算每一行的分数与名次: check_abox_sync recomputes every row's score and rank
en_blocks.被手改过的短名单（把某人刷到第一）会立刻被 check_abox_sync 抓到: A hand-edited shortlist (someone promoted to first) is caught immediately by check_abox_sync.
en_blocks.名单的两半：谁过线（推理）· 谁先看（SQL）: The two halves of a list: who clears (reasoning) · who to look at first (SQL)
en_blocks.三件必须说出来的事: Three things that must be said out loud
en_blocks.:missingData :UnknownYears 等记号； 门禁只对带记号的: :missingData :UnknownYears and friends; the gate only excuses gaps that carry the mark
en_blocks.4 个岗位有简历、没有职务说明书: 4 roles have résumés but no job description
en_blocks.行政专员 28 / 技术经理主管 14 / 设计工程师 10 / 实验室技术员: 行政专员 28 / 技术经理主管 14 / 设计工程师 10 / 实验室技术员 2 — refused by name, no threshold invented
en_blocks.人资专员 / 关务报关员 / 工程文员 —— 不给默认年限，声明为无法判定: 人资专员 / 关务报关员 / 工程文员 — no default years; declared as not judgeable
en_blocks.「这个人没有技能」和「我们没读出来」是两句不同的话。把它们并成一个数， 这个本体: “This person has no skills” and “we could not read it” are two different sentences. Merge them into one number and this ontology can no longer say how far it can be trusted.
en_blocks.缺口在 ABox 里是什么样子（实时查询）: What a gap looks like in the ABox (live query)
en_blocks.下面这些问题都能答（每条都有门禁背后的期望值）；答不了的时候它 按名拒绝 ， 不: All of the questions below can be answered (each has an expectation the gate compares against). When one cannot be answered it is refused by name — it never invents a number.
en_blocks.每个岗位有多少人过线: How many people clear each role
en_blocks.「那次下单时这条产线吃不吃紧」——库里只有当前快照: “Was that line under pressure when this order was placed” — the database holds only the current snapshot
en_blocks.某岗位的推荐名单与分数线: A role's shortlist and cut-off score
en_blocks.「这个人的回款准时率」——没有回款表: “This person's on-time payment rate” — there is no payments table
en_blocks.跨岗位过线人数: How many people clear more than one role
en_blocks.无 JD 的 4 个岗位的匹配判定: Judge the 4 roles that have no job description
en_blocks.有多少人年限/学历没读到: How many people have no years / education read
en_blocks.「谁最可能离职」——没有这类数据: “Who is most likely to resign” — there is no such data
